capabilities: tutor concepts from vault notes, library index cards, and raw PDF pages
index uploaded PDFs and docx files into topic folders with frontmatter index cards
search arXiv and the web for papers and verify publication metadata
synthesize evergreen notes with callouts, wikilinks, and Mermaid diagrams
filter the library by document kind, topic, author, or keyword
extras: Serverless by design: no Python backend, vector database, or local server; install is manual (copy release files into .obsidian/plugins). Works on mobile (iPad/iPhone) and supports Obsidian Sync / iCloud sync.
problem: Studying and managing academic literature usually means juggling external AI chat tools, reference managers, and manual note-taking instead of working inside the vault.

relations.evidence: using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Obsidian's native APIs

requires.name: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, or Groq

summary: Multi-agent AI research assistant that tutors on vault content, indexes PDFs/docx into a topic library, searches arXiv, and writes structured notes.
